copy-all-callsigns-30-apr-24.csv.contentsIndicative: header Value__c,Product__c,Status__c,Type__c (Salesforce object export, the '__c' custom-field suffix; no BOM, CRLF, latin-1). 154,582 data rows - 102,533 Allocated, 51,903 Reserved, 145 Available, 1 blank status. Product__c is the licence-product vocabulary verbatim (Full 58,928 / Foundation 35,075 / Intermediate 13,975 / Club 1,821 / Special Event Station 5 / Temporary Reciprocal 1) and blank on 44,777 rows (the reserved pool). Type__c is 'Call Sign - Amateur' throughout (service discriminator). No date columns. Anomalies preserved verbatim: 15 Excel-mangled Intermediate callsigns served as dates (20-Apr, 20-Nov, 21-Jan etc.); two over-length callsigns EDUCATIONAL and ENVIRONMENTS; lower-case 'g0jrk'; one callsign 'G7IWE' with a trailing raw 0xA0 (latin-1 NBSP, the file's only high byte) - trimmed and counted, after which G7IWE and G0TQK each appear twice (duplicate callsigns on the record).
